//: Composite indexes for privacy-filtered public reads. Every public query on archive_items and collections now carries where('is_private','==',false) (see src/lib/privacyQuery.ts), and Firestore needs a composite index for each shape that combines it with another filter or an orderBy. NOTE: `firebase deploy --only firestore` deploys this file DECLARATIVELY and deletes any production index not listed here — so this file is the authority, and indexes must land here and deploy BEFORE any query depends on them.

indexes.//: BrowseArchive, SearchArchive, BrowseMap — the whole archive, newest first.
Multi-collection membership: array-contains in CollectionDetail, array-contains-any in ItemDetail's explore query. Both disjuncts of an or() need their own index.
ItemDetail backward references — items that link TO this one. One index per relation field, because fetchBackward() is called with each in turn.
Collections.tsx — the public collection list, newest first.
